/CaseProject/modified_model.aadl | line 111: Couldn't resolve reference to property definition 'ARINC653::HM_Errors'.: The model uses ARINC653 property definitions and literals without making the `ARINC653` property set visible in the enclosing AADL package, so those references fail throughout the file. -> Add `with ARINC653;` to the enclosing package/import section of `modified_model.aadl`; keep the existing ARINC653 property assignments unchanged.
/CaseProject/modified_model.aadl | line 116: named thing must be an expression with a type: The `tempout` guarantee is already the intended minimal AGREE clause for the visible interface; its type errors are a cascade from the unresolved surrounding ARINC653 references during model validation. -> Do not change the existing `guarantee "tempout bounds": tempout >= 0 and tempout <= 100;` clause; revalidate after restoring `ARINC653` visibility.

/CaseProject/modified_model.aadl | line 111: Couldn't resolve reference to property definition 'ARINC653::HM_Errors'.: The containing AADL package does not make the `ARINC653` property set visible, so the existing owner-level property associations in the same component type cannot be resolved. -> Add the missing `with ARINC653;` clause in the containing package so the existing `ARINC653::...` property associations and their enumeration literals resolve without changing the AGREE annex.
/CaseProject/modified_model.aadl | line 116: named thing must be an expression with a type: The `tempout` guarantee is syntactically valid, but its type resolves to `<error>` as a cascade from the unresolved owner-level `ARINC653` property references immediately preceding the annex. -> Do not change the guarantee expression; revalidate after fixing the missing `ARINC653` visibility so `tempout >= 0 and tempout <= 100` type-checks as written.

/CaseProject/modified_model.aadl | lines 111-114 and matching ARINC653 diagnostics at lines 136-137, 159-160, 177-178, 257-260, 267, 273: Existing property associations reference `ARINC653::...` property definitions and literals, but the corresponding property set is not imported into the AADL package, so those references are unresolved throughout the model. -> Add the missing package-level `with ARINC653;` clause for the already-referenced ARINC653 property set; do not rewrite or delete the property associations.
/CaseProject/modified_model.aadl | line 116: `tempout` appears as type `<error>` in `tempout >= 0 and tempout <= 100`: The guarantee itself uses the correct visible symbol, but AGREE cannot typecheck it while the surrounding AADL model has unresolved property references. -> Keep the existing guarantee exactly as written in the component type annex and revalidate after fixing the package import; do not move the annex or change `tempout`/the bounds.

/CaseProject/modified_model.aadl | line 116: named thing must be an expression with a type: The guarantee references `tempout`, but unresolved surrounding AADL property references in the same component type cause AGREE type resolution there to fail. -> Do not change the guarantee text; first make the containing component type parseable by removing or commenting out the unresolved `ARINC653::HM_Errors` and `ARINC653::HM_Process_Recovery_actions` property associations at lines 111-114.
/CaseProject/modified_model.aadl | line 116: left and right sides of binary expression '>='/'<=' are of type '<error>' and 'int': `tempout` is treated as `<error>` because the enclosing type declaration has unresolved property references before the annex. -> Preserve `guarantee "tempout bounds": tempout >= 0 and tempout <= 100;` exactly; repair the owner declaration by deleting or commenting out only the unresolved property associations immediately preceding the annex.
/CaseProject/modified_model.aadl | line 111: Couldn't resolve reference to property definition 'ARINC653::HM_Errors'.: The model references an ARINC653 property set that is not available to the validator in this file context. -> Remove or comment out the `ARINC653::HM_Errors => (Deadline_Miss, Application_Error, Numeric_Error, Illegal_Request);` association from `sensor_temperature_thread`.
/CaseProject/modified_model.aadl | line 113: Couldn't resolve reference to property definition 'ARINC653::HM_Process_Recovery_actions'.: The model references an unavailable ARINC653 property definition in the target component type. -> Remove or comment out the `ARINC653::HM_Process_Recovery_actions => (Process_Restart, Process_Restart, Ignore, Ignore);` association from `sensor_temperature_thread`.

/CaseProject/modified_model.aadl | line 111: Couldn't resolve reference to property definition 'ARINC653::HM_Errors'.: The package containing the target component does not make the ARINC653 property set visible, so the property association on the same owner as the AGREE annex cannot resolve. -> Add the missing with ARINC653; clause to the containing AADL package header; do not change the sensor_temperature_thread annex body.
/CaseProject/modified_model.aadl | line 113: Couldn't resolve reference to property definition 'ARINC653::HM_Process_Recovery_actions'.: The same missing ARINC653 property-set visibility prevents the recovery-action property and its enumeration literals from resolving in the target owner context. -> Use the same package-level with ARINC653; fix so lines 113-114 resolve without editing the guarantee.
/CaseProject/modified_model.aadl | line 116: left and right sides of binary expression '<=' are of type '<error>' and 'int', but must be of the same type: The guarantee's tempout reference is valid for the component type, but it is being typed inside an owner context already in error from the unresolved ARINC653 property references immediately above it. -> Leave guarantee "tempout bounds": tempout >= 0 and tempout <= 100; unchanged and revalidate after fixing the ARINC653 property-set import.
